metadata.title: Global Port Community Systems Directory
metadata.description: Comprehensive dataset of Port Community Systems (PCS) and Single Window platforms worldwide, compiled from IPCSA membership data and public sources.
metadata.source: IPCSA (International Port Community Systems Association) - https://ipcsa.international/
metadata.author: Robert Richard das Neves Correia dos Santos
metadata.data_note: Dados baseados no diretório IPCSA e fontes públicas oficiais. Última verificação: Julho 2026.

pcs_systems.name: Portbase
pcs_systems.description: The national port community system of the Netherlands, providing services for all Dutch ports. It improves efficiency in the logistics chain.

pcs_systems.name: DAKOSY
pcs_systems.description: Data Communication System for the Port of Hamburg. It provides a wide range of services for shipping and forwarder communities.

pcs_systems.name: SOGET (S)ONE
pcs_systems.description: A leading French Port Community System facilitating trade and logistics operations. Deployed mainly in Le Havre but operates at a national level.

pcs_systems.name: Portic
pcs_systems.description: Port Community System for the Port of Barcelona. It streamlines documentary and physical processes for logistics players.

pcs_systems.name: MCP (Destin8)
pcs_systems.description: Maritime Cargo Processing provides the Destin8 PCS across various UK ports. It facilitates fast and efficient movement of cargo.

pcs_systems.name: dbh Logistics IT AG
pcs_systems.description: Logistics IT solutions provider handling the PCS for Bremen and Bremerhaven ports. It specializes in customs and port logistics software.

pcs_systems.name: NxtPort (APCS)
pcs_systems.description: Data sharing platform and PCS for the Port of Antwerp-Bruges. It aims to unlock the potential of sharing logistics data safely.

pcs_systems.name: ValenciaportPCS
pcs_systems.description: Electronic platform providing services to the Port of Valencia community. It integrates various logistics chain participants.

pcs_systems.name: CNS (Compass)
pcs_systems.description: Community Network Services operates Compass PCS mainly in Southampton. It serves as a vital communications hub for maritime trade.

pcs_systems.name: MGI (Ci5)
pcs_systems.description: MGI operates the Ci5 Cargo Intelligent System in Marseille. It connects various stakeholders in the supply chain.

pcs_systems.name: TPCS
pcs_systems.description: Tuscan Port Community System serving Livorno. Connects local port users to enhance efficiency.

pcs_systems.name: Polski PCS
pcs_systems.description: The Polish Port Community System covering major Polish ports. Centralizes documentation and operations across the country.

pcs_systems.name: HPCS
pcs_systems.description: Hellenic Port Community System located in Piraeus. Focuses on regional maritime and port logistics.

pcs_systems.name: Teleport (APBA)
pcs_systems.description: Teleport is the Port Community System of Algeciras Bay. Manages complex transit operations efficiently.

pcs_systems.name: UIRNet / Sinfomar
pcs_systems.description: Italian national logistics platform integrated with local port community services. Key deployment includes Sinfomar in Genoa.

pcs_systems.name: JUL - Janela Única Logística
pcs_systems.description: Portugal's national Single Logistics Window. Replaces traditional paper processes across Portuguese ports.

pcs_systems.name: Portnet
pcs_systems.description: Nationwide business-to-business port community solution for Singapore. It enables seamless integration across port sectors.

pcs_systems.name: KL-Net (PORT-MIS)
pcs_systems.description: Korean national logistics network system focusing heavily on maritime logistics. Provides port and customs EDI services.

pcs_systems.name: NACCS
pcs_systems.description: Nippon Automated Cargo and Port Consolidated System for Japan. Serves as a unified single window for trade procedures.

pcs_systems.name: Port Klang Net
pcs_systems.description: Local PCS for Malaysia's primary port. Streamlines cargo clearance and port processes.

pcs_systems.name: Kale CODEX
pcs_systems.description: Digital platform deployed in major Indian ports including JNPT. Facilitates electronic exchange of trade-related documents.

pcs_systems.name: LOGINK
pcs_systems.description: China's National Transportation Logistics Public Information Platform. Integrates extensive logistics and shipping data nationwide.

pcs_systems.name: Inaportnet
pcs_systems.description: Indonesia's national port portal system. Facilitates ship and cargo clearance procedures.

pcs_systems.name: TPCS / T-Port
pcs_systems.description: Emerging port community platform for Thailand's Laem Chabang port. Currently in implementation phase.

pcs_systems.name: Vietnam PCS
pcs_systems.description: Pilot stage port community system for Vietnamese ports. Designed to modernize local trade operations.

pcs_systems.name: Dubai Trade
pcs_systems.description: Comprehensive single window for trade and logistics in Dubai. Connects the port, customs, and economic zones.

pcs_systems.name: Maqta Gateway
pcs_systems.description: Port Community System for Abu Dhabi Ports. Digitalizes trade management and operations.

pcs_systems.name: FASAH
pcs_systems.description: Saudi Arabia's integrated national platform for import and export. A single window for trade transactions.

pcs_systems.name: Asyad (Bayan)
pcs_systems.description: National single window and logistics system for Oman. Streamlines customs and port procedures.

pcs_systems.name: PortNet
pcs_systems.description: National Single Window for foreign trade in Morocco. Connects public and private stakeholders across logistics chains.

pcs_systems.name: KenTrade (KENTWS)
pcs_systems.description: Kenya Trade Network Agency providing national single window systems. Simplifies cross-border trade processes.

pcs_systems.name: TNPA
pcs_systems.description: Transnet National Ports Authority system implementation. Developing integrated port management tools.

pcs_systems.name: GUCE
pcs_systems.description: Guichet Unique des Opérations du Commerce Extérieur for Cameroon. Provides single window services nationally.

pcs_systems.name: GAINDE 2000
pcs_systems.description: Single window provider in Senegal specializing in customs and trade facilitation. Widely used across the national network.

pcs_systems.name: Nafeza
pcs_systems.description: National single window for foreign trade facilitation in Egypt. Handles cargo information tracking and processing.

pcs_systems.name: DPCS
pcs_systems.description: Djibouti Port Community System designed to enhance cargo flows. Currently in implementation stages.

pcs_systems.name: Port Optimizer
pcs_systems.description: Information portal designed to digitize maritime shipping data for Los Angeles. Enhances supply chain visibility and performance.

pcs_systems.name: eModal
pcs_systems.description: Widespread port community system used across multiple US ports. Facilitates container equipment management and appointments.

pcs_systems.name: Suape PCS
pcs_systems.description: Port Community System implementation at the Port of Suape. Aims to digitalize local maritime logistics processes.

pcs_systems.name: Porto Sem Papel
pcs_systems.description: Paperless Port initiative acting as a single window for maritime operations in Brazil. Nationwide coverage.

pcs_systems.name: VUCE
pcs_systems.description: Foreign Trade Single Window for Peru. Integrates administrative procedures for external trade.

pcs_systems.name: SICEX / VUCE Argentina
pcs_systems.description: Argentina's Foreign Trade Single Window regime. Streamlines and unifies processes and documentation.

pcs_systems.name: VUCEM
pcs_systems.description: Mexican Digital Window for Foreign Trade. Facilitates the submission of documentation relating to customs and trade.

pcs_systems.name: VUCE Colombia
pcs_systems.description: Foreign Trade Single Window of Colombia. Coordinates official processes for importers and exporters.

pcs_systems.name: 1-Stop Connections
pcs_systems.description: Major port community platform in Australia operating nationwide. Facilitates scheduling and cargo movement.

pcs_systems.name: PortConnect
pcs_systems.description: Centralized system connecting ports of Auckland and Lyttelton with the wider freight community.
